summary: Validated new Tutor IA feedback persistence + stats chart feature end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (happy path POST persists in Mongo tutor_feedback collection, upsert keyed on sessionId+messageId, rating clear to null, all 4 validation errors return 400 with correct detail messages, OPTIONS preflight returns 204, exported HTML inlines all 5 required new markers: tutor-stats-button / data-testid=\"tutor-stats-pane\" / toggleStats / /api/tutor/feedback / tutor-stats-bar-chart). Frontend Playwright on /tutor_test/ harness: tutor-stats-button visible, toggleStats() correctly shows tutor-stats-pane + hides tutor-messages, empty state tutor-stats-empty renders when no questions asked, second click restores messages, rateMessage() fires a POST to /api/tutor/feedback with the expected JSON payload (sessionId, messageId, rating, projectId, companyId, question, answer), all regression testids from iteration 126 still present (FAB, panel, maximize, backdrop, close, copy, thumbs up/down, input, send, messages, counter). All tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py:382/384 — 400s use raw FastAPI HTTPException; tests assert on detail substring 'sessionId'/'messageId'/'rating' which matches. Good.
tutor.js rateMessage() POST is best-effort with try/catch + .catch + keepalive:true — exactly the right pattern for SCORM/LMS-hosted widgets where the parent frame may unload mid-request.
feedbackStore is still in-memory client-side — server is source of truth via upsert. If the user closes the course mid-session, only the last clicked rating is persisted (which is correct).
tutor_feedback Mongo collection has no index on (sessionId, messageId) declared in code — for a future scaling concern, an admin migration should add a compound unique index. Not blocking.
rateMessage payload includes companyId from config but the harness/exporter doesn't currently set config.companyId — backend gracefully stores null. Verified in test.
/api/tutor/feedback is public by design (no auth) — appropriate given the SCORM/LMS context. Recommend gateway-level rate limiting (out of code scope).

seed_data_creation: All test docs use TEST_sess_<uuid> sessionIds and are deleted by per-test try/finally cleanup. Frontend test uses harness /tutor_test/ which loads refreshed export_assets copies.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refreshed /app/frontend/public/tutor_test/{tutor.js,tutor.css} from export_assets/ — always re-copy before running the harness. Harness apiUrl is intentionally http://localhost-disabled to prevent real backend fetches during UI tests; monkey-patch window.fetch to capture rateMessage() POSTs. Backend pytest now hits the public preview URL with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL loaded via python-dotenv (added since BASE_URL isn't naturally in the shell). Mongo verification uses sync pymongo instead of motor to keep things simple. The export_html job is polled via GET /api/job/{job_id}, completed status carries result.downloadUrl (relative path that needs BASE_URL prefix).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature passed all tests on first full run after fixing test scaffolding (env loading + sync mongo).
